newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah recovers in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah recovers in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah recovered against the dollar in slow trading on Tuesday after sliding earlier as band rumours diminished, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said trading was sluggish because offshore operators were focusing on the ringgit and the peso.
"There is not much volume today. The rupiah recovered on buying from local and offshore players," the dealer said.
He said there was no fresh factor which caused the rebound, but some rupiah purchases by selective state banks seemed to generate some follow-through from offshore operators.
Spot rupiah was at 2,431.5/31.8 at 0915 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,431.00/31.75. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,431.15/31.40 and 2,432.5/33.0, respectively.
"There is no fresh factor. Rumours of a band widening seems to have died down as well," the dealer said, adding swaps were slightly biddish on jitters in the peso and ringgit.
The rupiah weakened in the morning after a fresh economic deregulation package announced on Monday did not contain the widening of the central bank intervention band.
Indonesia unveiled an economic deregulation package which cut tariffs on 1,600 items.
The government also moved to limit loans to the property sector to anticipate undesirable effects.
However, the central bank did not announce anything linked to the widely speculated widening of the dollar-rupiah band, removing some of the arguments for going short in dollars.
But some analysts said sentiment remained positive because the package had helped the stock market to post several record highs in the past few days and was still on track.
They said the impact from the deregulation package might not be significant but it did stimulate certain sectors.
Liquidity supply was sufficient, with overnight rates falling to 8.5 percent from 13.5 percent in the morning.
Overnight swap was at 0.35/0.45 and tom/next at 0.45/0.48.
One-month swaps edged up to 14.25/14.75 from 14.00/14.25, two to 27.5/29.0 from 26.5/27.5, three to 41.0/42.0 from 40.0/41.0 and six to 83.5/85.0 from 81.5/83.5 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,429/2,621 and the conversion band also by one point to 2,429/2,477 on Tuesday.
